_help: HUD widget top-left positions in 1366x768 space. Sizes stay in code (they must match the art). hinticon = the target icon offset inside the four hint cells; hintcap = the key cap offset inside the same cells (the twelve item cells center their icon and keep the cap in the bottom-right corner). The game windows (inventory, stat, skill, quest, settings) have their own file: layouts/panel-<name>.json. Keys may be omitted (keeps current value). DEBUG builds reload this file live on save; the file wins over dragged panels.
